content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-313. - Appeals procedure.
content.summary:
Any decision rendered by the director pursuant to this article may be appealed within
               30 days by the permittee to the city manager in accordance with the rules and procedures
               established by that body.
(Code 1981, § 27-222; Ord. No. 3717, § 1, 8-27-2001)
